reader_summary.overview: On today's Manager Meeting, Paula Volent interviews Steve Drobny. Paula is a legend in the endowment world and recent guest on Capital Allocators who is now serving as the CIO for Rockefeller University's $2.5 billion endowment after spending twenty years at the helm of Bowdoin College's endowment..

key_points.text: Paula is a legend in the endowment world and recent guest on Capital Allocators who is now serving as the CIO for Rockefeller University's $2.5 billion endowment after spending twenty years at the helm of Bowdoin College's endowment..
Steve is the Founder and Managing Partner of Clocktower Group.
Their conversation covers the changing global landscape, geopolitics, China, fintech, Latin America, and ESG.
